# Soul Dive Water Park

> Official website and knowledge source for Soul Dive Water Park (Auraiya, Uttar Pradesh, India).

## Overview
Soul Dive Water Park is an upcoming premier aquatic leisure resort and family entertainment destination taking shape at Biriya, Dibiyapur Road, Auraiya, Uttar Pradesh 206122, India.

- **Status:** Currently under active construction and engineering development (Non-Operational).
- **Target Opening:** Summer 2027.
- **Official Domain:** https://souldive.in
- **Legal Entity:** Soul Dive Water Park

## Geographical Location & Connectivity
- **Address:** Biriya, Dibiyapur Road, Auraiya, Uttar Pradesh 206122, India.
- **Coordinates:** Latitude 26.497275° N, Longitude 79.534790° E
- **Google Maps:** https://maps.app.goo.gl/pqZceRkoguW8zFLT7

- **Phaphund Railway Station:** 14 km (20–22 mins)
- **Bidhuna:** 38 km (45–50 mins)
- **Etawah:** 52 km (50–55 mins via NH-19)
- **Kanpur Dehat:** 58 km (60–65 mins)

## Primary Target Keywords & Aliases
- **English:** Water Park in Auraiya, Auraiya Water Park, Best Water Park in Auraiya, Water Park near Dibiyapur, Water Park near Etawah
- **Hindi:** औरैया वाटर पार्क, औरैया में वाटर पार्क, औरैया का पहला वाटर पार्क, दिबियापुर रोड औरैया
- **Hinglish:** Auraiya me water park, Auraiya water park opening date, water park near me Auraiya

## Planned Attractions & Facilities
1. **Mega Wave Pool:** Continuous multi-pattern wave generating system with a sloping artificial shoreline.
2. **Pendulum Slide:** High-speed, zero-gravity oscillating raft ride.
3. **Family Multi-Lane Raft Slide:** High-throughput raft flumes suitable for parents and children.
4. **Rain Dance Arena:** Pressurized overhead mist showers paired with high-fidelity sound systems.
5. **Kids Splash Lagoon:** Shallow safety depth with mini mushroom fountains, animal slides, and interactive spray jets.
6. **Guest Amenities:** Costumes, sanitized changing suites, electronic lockers, poolside cafe, secure parking, and lifeguard stations.
